rules.rule: requireScope(ctx, "write") is the first line of every write verb, before input parsing or the transaction.
rules.why: API-key and MCP read-only keys could mutate data or fire webhooks if the check is missed or moved.

rules.rule: Every service mutation runs in withTransaction with emitAudit in the same transaction and filters reads and writes by ctx.workspace.id.
rules.why: A missed emitAudit leaves audit gaps and a missing workspace filter leaks data between tenants.

checks.why: the requireScope and emitAudit lint rules

rules.rule: packages/services imports no node:* modules and no logtape.
rules.why: The status-page proxy imports page-access and Edge builds break.

rules.rule: impactUptimeWeight stays 1, 0.5 and 0 for major, partial and degraded.
rules.why: Uptime shown on every status page changes; these were changed and reverted before.

rules.rule: requireWriteScope() stays mounted after authMiddleware on the V1 router.
rules.why: V1 writes use inline Drizzle, so service-level checks never run and read-only keys could write.

rules.rule: MCP tools register through registerScopedTool with a declared scope.
rules.why: A tool registered the plain way is listed for read-only keys.

rules.rule: Any tRPC procedure or route returning status-page content calls assertPageAccess, and tRPC input is never logged.
rules.why: Password-protected pages leak to anonymous visitors, and input carries page passwords and subscriber tokens.

rules.rule: The checker status transition (status CAS, incident, outbox) stays a single db.batch in transition.ts.
rules.why: A crash between separate writes leaves the monitor status behind or loses or duplicates notifications.

rules.rule: Assertion evaluation changes in apps/checker/pkg/assertions and packages/assertions in the same PR.
rules.why: The probe and the dashboard silently disagree about whether a check passed.

rules.rule: Files in packages/ui/src/components/blocks are listed in registry.json and import no app code.
rules.why: They work in the monorepo and break or 404 for everyone installing the public registry.
